title: Har waqt zamane
body:
Azadahar waqt zamane saare mein
shabbir ka matam hota hai
sajjad to rone waale hai
tatheer ka matam hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rona bhi ibadat hai lekin
isko bhi ibadat kehte hai
kuch aag pe matam karte hai
zanjeer ka matam hota hai
har waqt zamane...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo baazu kaun se hai dekho
kat kar bhi alam ke saath rahe
us faatahe khyber hyder ki
tasveer ka matam hota hai
har waqt zamane...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamshakle payambar ko dekho
barchi ko sambhale soye hai
qasim pe jawani roti hai
baysheer ka matam hota hai
har waqt zamane...
ri
